blocks.text: Student Learning Outcomes (is unit mein kya seekhenge)
Is chapter ke aakhir tak aap yeh kar sakenge:

items: data science ki interdisciplinary (kai shobon ko milane wali) nature samajh sakenge, aur data ki mukhtalif qismein, data collect (jama) karne ke tareeqe aur storage (mehfooz rakhne) ki techniques samajh sakenge. Woh data science, machine learning aur data visualization (data ko chart aur graph mein dikhana) mein maharat (proficiency) dikhayenge, in skills ko asal duniya ke business challenges (karobari masail) hal karne mein istemal karenge, aur nataij (findings) ko advanced data visuals (achhe charts aur graphs) se bata sakenge.

blocks.text: Is chapter mein aap data aur analysis (data ko parakhna) ki bunyadi baatein seekhenge, aur yeh bhi ke aaj ki computing mein in ki kya ahmiyat hai. Aap data science ki bunyad dekhenge aur data ki mukhtalif qismein samjhenge, jaise structured aur unstructured data, aur data collect (jama) karne aur store (mehfooz) karne ke tareeqe bhi. Chapter machine learning ka ta'aruf karata hai: aisa tareeqa jis mein system data se seekh kar faisle karta hai. Phir yeh batata hai ke model ki performance (karkardagi) accuracy, precision, recall aur F1-score jaise pemaanon se kaise jaanchi jati hai, aur validation aur tuning se model ko kaise behtar kiya jata hai. Aakhir mein Excel, R aur Python jaise aam tools aate hain jo data science aur machine learning mein istemal hote hain.
